name: devlens-cli
description: Local repository graphs and dependency analysis

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @devlens/web build && tsup cli/src/index.ts --format esm --platform node --target node20 --out-dir dist --no-splitting && pnpm --filter devlens build && node scripts/copy-dashboard.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.package: pnpm build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('release', { recursive: true })" && npm pack ./cli --pack-destination release
